Q5803.reason: Drug-use or treatment status is not a suspect or quasi-suspect class and public employment is not a fundamental right, so the regulation is reviewed only for a rational relation to a legitimate safety interest.

Q5805.reason: A joint tenant's inter vivos conveyance of her share severs the joint tenancy as to that share, so the grantee held a devisable one-third tenancy in common that passed by will to her son.

Q5807.reason: Deadly force is not privileged merely to protect property or to stop a fleeing petty thief who had already dropped the rake, so the shooting was unreasonable force.
